h1: Custom Box Fit Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Box Fit Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom box fit shirts for your team. Perfect for a modern, relaxed look. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Box fit shirts offer a modern, relaxed silhouette that provides extra room through the chest and shoulders without looking oversized. This cut is ideal for employees who prefer a less restrictive fit or for layering over other garments. Whether you need branded button-downs for a trade show or henleys for a casual team uniform, box fit styles from brands like Elemental Coffee Shirts and Vansport deliver comfort and a contemporary look. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a polished finish.
heroAltText: Custom box fit shirts in various colors and styles, featuring a relaxed fit for comfort and layering.
